item.description: OSWEGO, N.Y. item.title: Oswego diner braves snowstorm to serve community hot meals
item.description: Wade's Diner in Oswego, NY remained open during a powerful lake effect snowstorm to provide food and coffee to those stranded by the heavy snowfall, including an ICU nurse who was unable to reach her home.

item.title: 'It still scares me to this day,' Skaneateles firefighter battles the fire that destroyed his family's home
item.description: The Evans family in Skaneateles lost their home to a fire on January 20, but the community came together to raise nearly $91,000 to help them get back on their feet.

item.title: Seventh annual Syracuse Winter Fair returns this weekend
